content.headline: What stayed with you?
content.body: Which sister did you believe? Did the ending land the way you expected? And what did you make of that set? Whoever you came with saw a different play - talk it over at the bar.
Enjoy making things happen? Try costumes, props, lighting, sound, bar or front-of-house. Bring your skills, discover a new interest and meet the company.

content.quote: I had to go into the wardrobe at one point and burst out when the phone rang. One night the phone did not ring, and after what seemed like a very long time one of the other actors proclaimed, very loudly, ‘You can come out now!’
content.author: Anne-marie Greene
content.role: In the cast, with Cathryn Bowler
